global_acceptance.boundary: All recovered reachable app flows in this ledger pass using local simulated services. Numeric holes remain unobserved. No whole-ROM execution, hardware/cloud success or exact pixel parity of SIM-specific service diagnostics is asserted.

additional_behaviors.name: 未配置启动和长按
additional_behaviors.behavior: Mijia initial setup, guide gate, physical 3 second hold, configured/unconfigured destinations and OTA hold guard

additional_behaviors.name: 无独立构造器的恢复状态
additional_behaviors.behavior: selection 75 TA1208 bootloader-required repair; same-version target1 package, withdraw and disconnect exit

additional_behaviors.name: 端口事务失效
additional_behaviors.behavior: bank/ordinary USB replacement, capabilities and disconnect cancel pending and retire stale successful protocol results

additional_behaviors.name: 异步服务与更新目标隔离
additional_behaviors.behavior: binding/weather/check/OTA finite jobs; latched disconnect, busy guards and separate two-target validated package records

additional_behaviors.name: 持久化与工厂复位
additional_behaviors.behavior: bounded version/count/length/CRC, atomic readback replace, corrupt record refusal and explicit reset, versions preserved

additional_behaviors.name: 控制接口会话与重放
additional_behaviors.behavior: startup retires leftovers; session/id/payload and high-water fence; unknown result after process change; status preserves business error
